titleEn: Langley Kitchen Renovation Cost 2026: Real Project Prices From $20,000
titleZh: 兰里厨房装修费用2026：真实项目价格从$20,000起
contentEn:
Langley kitchen renovations in 2026 cost from $20,000 to over $35,000, depending on cabinet scope, countertop material, and whether structural changes are involved. Reno Stars has completed three kitchen projects in Langley this year, and this guide breaks down exactly what those projects cost, why prices vary, and what drives the final bill for Langley homeowners.

What Do Langley Kitchen Renovations Actually Cost in 2026?

Three completed Langley kitchen projects by Reno Stars provide real 2026 pricing benchmarks. These figures include materials, labour, and GST, and represent work completed in the Township of Langley and the City of Langley in 2026.

These are all-inclusive project costs including demolition, permitting coordination, and finishing. The shortest project (3–4 weeks) involved an open-concept reconfiguration with pre-existing cabinet locations; the longer projects required structural modifications.

Planning a kitchen renovation in Langley, Surrey, or the surrounding Township? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars based on your specific layout and material preferences.

What Drives the Cost of a Langley Kitchen Renovation?

Cabinetry is the single largest line item in most Langley kitchen renovations, accounting for 30–45% of total project cost. Custom full-overlay shaker cabinets in solid wood run $8,000–$18,000 for a typical 10×12 ft kitchen. Laminate-surface cabinets are a lower-cost alternative starting around $5,000–$9,000 for the same footprint.

Countertops add $2,500–$8,000 depending on material. Laminate starts around $1,500–$2,500 for a standard kitchen. Quartz, the most common premium choice in Langley renovations in 2026, typically runs $3,500–$7,000 installed. Natural stone such as granite adds further cost.

Plumbing and electrical upgrades are required in roughly 60% of Langley kitchen renovations, as many homes in Walnut Grove, Willoughby, and Brookswood have original wiring or galvanized supply lines from the 1970s–1990s. Budget $2,000–$5,000 for a licensed electrician and $1,500–$3,500 for a plumber in these situations.

Flooring replacement — often subfloor remediation in older Langley homes — adds $2,000–$5,000 depending on whether the existing structure is sound. New luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring runs $3–$8 per sq ft installed.

Appliances are typically a separate homeowner purchase and not included in general contractor quotes, unless specified. A quality appliance package (French-door refrigerator, gas range, dishwasher, range hood) costs $5,000–$12,000 in 2026.

Langley-Specific Cost Factors

Langley presents specific cost drivers that differ from Vancouver or Richmond. Homes in Willoughby and Township areas are often newer construction (1990s–2010s) with relatively open layouts, reducing demolition costs. Brookswood and rural properties may involve asbestos assessment (budget $800–$2,500 if suspected) and longer material delivery lead times.

Strata properties in Langley condo and townhouse complexes require Strata approval before any plumbing or electrical work that affects common property. Reno Stars handles Strata application coordination as part of its project management service, typically included in the contract value.

Permit costs in Langley are set by the Township of Langley. A kitchen renovation permit (structural or layout changes) runs approximately $300–$600. Electrical permits through BC Safety Authority add approximately $100–$200. These are included in Reno Stars' standard project quotes.

How Long Does a Langley Kitchen Renovation Take?

Based on Reno Stars' three completed Langley projects in 2026: a standard cabinet-and-counter replacement takes 3–5 weeks from permit application to final inspection. A full reconfiguration with structural changes takes 5–8 weeks. All three completed Langley projects were finished within their initial estimate.

The longest phase is typically waiting on materials — custom cabinetry requires 3–5 weeks lead time from order to delivery in the Langley market. Reno Stars places cabinet orders in week one so fabrication runs parallel to demolition and rough-in.

Real Projects in Langley

See the Waterfall Island project in Langley: a complete custom-cabinet kitchen with island, installed for $28,000–$30,000 over 4–6 weeks.

See the Modern Quartz Kitchen in Langley: premium quartz countertops and integrated appliances, completed for $32,000–$35,000 in 3–4 weeks.

See the White Shaker Kitchen project: full cabinet replacement with new lighting, completed for $20,000–$23,000 in 4–5 weeks.

Langley Kitchen Renovation FAQ

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Langley BC in 2026?

Based on three completed Reno Stars projects in Langley in 2026, a full kitchen renovation costs $20,000–$35,000 depending on cabinet scope, countertop material, and whether structural changes are involved. Premium custom builds can exceed $40,000. These figures include all materials, labour, and GST.

Does Langley require a permit for kitchen renovation?

The Township of Langley requires a building permit for any kitchen renovation involving structural changes, moved plumbing, or altered electrical circuits. A simple cabinet and countertop replacement may proceed under an expedited permit. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of its standard project management service.

How long does a Langley kitchen renovation take?

A standard cabinet-and-countertop replacement in Langley takes 3–5 weeks from permit approval to final inspection. A full reconfiguration with structural changes takes 5–8 weeks. The longest variable is cabinet lead time, which runs 3–5 weeks for custom builds.

Should I get multiple quotes for a Langley kitchen renovation?

Yes — as with any major home improvement project, obtaining at least three written quotes is standard practice in the Langley market. Quotes should include a detailed scope of work, material specifications, a project schedule, and a clear description of what is and is not included. Reno Stars provides detailed written quotes at no charge for Langley homeowners.

Can I live in my home during a Langley kitchen renovation?

Most Langley homeowners continue living in their home during a kitchen renovation, using a temporary kitchen setup. Reno Stars coordinates work schedules to minimise disruption and ensures the home remains secure and weather-tight throughout the project.

2026年兰里厨房装修费用从$20,000到$35,000以上不等，具体取决于橱柜范围、台面材料以及是否有结构改动。聚星装修今年已在兰里完成了三个厨房项目，本指南详细说明这些项目的实际成本、价格差异原因，以及影响兰里业主最终账单的因素。

2026年兰里厨房装修实际费用是多少？

聚星装修完成的三个兰里厨房项目提供了2026年真实价格基准。这些费用包含材料、人工和GST，代表2026年在兰里镇和兰里市完成的项目。

项目预算范围工期工程范围

瀑布式中岛厨房$28,000–$30,0004–6周瀑布式中岛，定制橱柜，石英石台面
现代石英石厨房$32,000–$35,0003–4周全面装修，优质石英石及家电整合

这些均为全包项目费用，包括拆除、许可证协调和收尾工作。最短项目（3–4周）为开放式重新配置，原有橱柜位置不变；较长的项目则涉及结构改造。

正在计划兰里、素里或周边地区厨房装修？联系聚星装修获取免费、无约束力的报价，根据您的具体布局和材料偏好定制。

是什么影响了兰里厨房装修的成本？

橱柜是大多数兰里厨房装修中最大的单项支出，占总成本的30%至45%。典型10×12英尺厨房的实心木全覆式定制橱柜价格从$8,000到$18,000不等。层压板面橱柜是更低成本的替代方案，相同面积起步价约$5,000至$9,000。

台面根据材料不同增加$2,500至$8,000。层压板台面起步价约$1,500至$2,500（标准厨房）。石英石是2026年兰里装修中最常见的优质选择，通常$3,500至$7,000（含安装）。天然石材如花岗岩则成本更高。

管道和电气升级在约60%的兰里厨房装修中是必需的，因为Willoughby、Walnut Grove和Brookswood地区的许多房屋拥有1970年代至1990年代的原装线路或镀锌供水管道。在此情况下，需预算$2,000至$5,000（电工）和$1,500至$3,500（水管工）。

地板更换——通常涉及老旧兰里房屋的底层地板修复——根据现有结构状况增加$2,000至$5,000。新豪华乙烯基塑料（LVP）地板含安装每平方尺$3至$8。

家电通常由业主单独购买，不包含在总承包商报价中（除非特别说明）。2026年一套优质家电组合（法式门冰箱、燃气灶、洗碗机、抽油烟机）价格$5,000至$12,000。

兰里特定成本因素

兰里具有与温哥华或列治文不同的特定成本驱动因素。Willoughby和镇区较新建筑（1990年代至2010年代）通常布局较开放，拆除成本较低。Brookswood和农村物业可能需要石棉评估（疑似情况下预算$800至$2,500），材料交付准备时间更长。

兰里公寓和联排别墅小区的分层物业在影响公共财产的任何管道或电气工程之前需要分层审批。聚星装修作为项目管理服务的一部分处理分层申请协调，通常包含在合同价值中。

兰里的许可证费用由兰里镇设定。厨房装修许可证（结构或布局改动）约$300至$600。通过BC安全管理局的电气许可证另加约$100至$200。这些已包含在聚星装修的标准项目报价中。

兰里厨房装修需要多长时间？

根据聚星装修2026年完成的三个兰里项目：标准橱柜和台面更换从许可证申请到最终验收需要3至5周。涉及结构改动的全面重新配置需要5至8周。所有三个已完成的兰里项目均在初始估计时间内完成。

最长阶段通常是等待材料——定制橱柜从下单到交货在兰里市场需要3至5周。聚星装修在第一周即下订单，使制作与拆除和粗糙装修并行进行。

兰里厨房装修常见问题

2026年兰里不列颠哥伦比亚省厨房装修费用是多少？

根据聚星装修2026年在兰里完成的三个项目，全面厨房装修费用为$20,000至$35,000，取决于橱柜范围、台面材料和是否有结构改动。优质定制装修可能超过$40,000。这些费用包含所有材料、人工和GST。

兰里厨房装修需要许可证吗？

兰里镇要求涉及结构改动、移动管道或改变电路的任何厨房装修持有建筑许可证。简单的橱柜和台面更换可能通过快速许可证处理。聚星装修作为标准项目管理服务的一部分处理所有许可证申请。

兰里厨房装修需要多长时间？

兰里厨房装修我应该多方比较报价吗？

是的——与任何大型家庭装修项目一样，在兰里市场获取至少三份书面报价是标准做法。报价应包括详细的工作范围、材料规格、项目进度表，以及明确说明包含和不包含的内容。聚星装修为兰里业主免费提供详细书面报价。

兰里厨房装修期间我可以住在家里吗？

大多数兰里业主在厨房装修期间继续居住，使用临时厨房设置。聚星装修协调工作时间表以减少干扰，并确保整个项目期间房屋保持安全和防风雨。
